title: Theo and the Crown
author: Juniper Underhill
blurb: Tamsin Ravensworth, a mercenary sworn to a god that went silent, has spent twelve years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must find the door out of a country that no longer exists before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
